abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: Muradin restores 55 Health per second when he has not taken damage for 4 seconds. When below 40% Health, increased to 111 Health per second.

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.text:
Throw a hammer, dealing 110 damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds

Quest: Basic Attack Heroes affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks. If the Hero dies within 3 seconds, gain 5 stacks.

Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds and restore 3 Mana.

<Mythic Reward: Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.text: Blast nearby enemies for 96 damage and Slow them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

abilities.name: Dwarf Toss
abilities.text: Leap to target location, dealing 59 damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.text: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 Health.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.text: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 damage and knocking them aside.

1.name: Dwarf Block
1.text: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

1.name: Third Wind
1.text: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 per second Restoration.

1.name: Give 'em the Axe!
1.text: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Sledgehammer
4.text: Storm Bolt deals 500% damage to non-Heroic enemies. Stormbolt cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

4.name: Reverberation
4.text: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

4.name: Thunder Burn
4.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 damage.

7.name: Perfect Storm
7.text: Storm Bolt's cooldown is reset and 25 Mana is refunded if an enemy dies within 3 seconds of being hit by it. This effect has an 8.5 second cooldown.

7.name: Heavy Impact
7.text: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

7.name: Skullcracker
7.text: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Avatar
10.text: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 Health.

10.name: Haymaker
10.text: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 damage and knocking them aside.

13.name: Bronzebeard Rage
13.text: Deal 15 damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Healing Static
13.text: Muradin heals for 6% of his maximum Health for each Hero hit by Thunder Clap.

13.name: Thunder Strike
13.text:
Thunder Clap deals 200% more damage if only one target is hit.

Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

16.name: Dwarf Launch
16.text: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

16.name: Stoneform
16.text: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

16.name: Imposing Presence
16.text:
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

20.name: Unstoppable Force
20.text: While active, Avatar grants 20 Armor and causes Muradin's Basic Attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss by 0.75 seconds.

20.name: Grand Slam
20.text: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

20.name: Mountain King
20.text: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

20.name: Hardened Shield
20.text: Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.
